html:
SMTO-MEM-0038 — SMTO can't read this Knowledge document

GUID: 8717bcd7-7168-5d15-bab2-1c33e449e220
Slug: knowledge-source-unavailable
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • SMTO went to open a document's saved copy and couldn't. Either the file is missing from the server, or the document isn't part of this conversation's sources anymore.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Knowledge, choose the conversation under This conversation, and select Show conversation sources. Check the document is listed and not excluded. SMTO can only read documents that belong to this conversation or to a collection attached to it.
  2. If the document was excluded, select Restore excluded documents. If its collection was detached, select it and use Attach selected collection. This makes the document available to the conversation again.
  3. If the document is listed but Preview fails, open Manage on its card, select Replace, and choose the original file from your computer. Replacing stores a fresh copy when the server's copy is missing.
  4. If you were importing a file attached in the conversation, attach the file again and repeat the import. The earlier attachment could not be read, so SMTO needs a new copy.

What success looks like

  • Preview shows the document's content and source links open.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, naming the document. Don't edit or delete files in SMTO's data folder yourself.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A Knowledge source could not be read: its stored file is missing or is a symlink (RagStore.read_asset), the referenced document is not available to this conversation (RagService.fetch, rag.fetch), or the attached file could not be bound or read during import.

What this means

  • The source file or its retained content cannot be read for this request. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported source_unavailable. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • Preview can read the source.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Check that the asset exists as a regular file under the rag-files directory beside the Knowledge store, that the document is still bound to the conversation (not deleted, excluded or detached), and for imports that the saved context file exists in the context store. Re-upload or Replace the document if its stored file is gone.
  • Check that the original file still exists and is readable, then replace or upload it again in Knowledge.

Retry and execution caution

  • Preview can read the source.

How to verify the fix

  • Preview can read the source.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
